figures.caption: Figure 1: Illustration of existing RAGRec methods and our proposed MixRAGRec methods. (a) Existing RAGRec methods apply the same KG retrieval granularity to all queries, causing either noise from over-retrieval or missing knowledge from under-retrieval; (b) Our MixRAGRec routes queries of different complexity to appropriate retrieval granularity, improving the utility–cost trade-off.

Figure 2: The overview of theMixRAGRec, which consists of three agents: (1)Mixture-of-Experts Retrieval Agent selects a retrieval expert to obtain structured knowledge, (2) Knowledge Preference Alignment Agent converts the retrieved KG knowledge into an LLM-friendly representation, and (3) Contrastive Learning-reinforced Recommendation Agent produces the recommendation. Mixture-of-Experts Multi-Agent Policy Optimization (MMAPO) jointly optimizes these agents under a shared objective.
Table 2: Performance comparison across LLM-based recommendation baselines and KG-RAG methods. Best results are in bold and the second-best results are underlined.
Figure 4: Ablation results of MixRAGRec and five variants on MovieLens-1M and LFM-1K with the LLaMA3-8B backbone. We report Accuracy, Recall@3, and Recall@5.
